title: Keith Tucker
description: "[SWG Editor] Gary Gerani suggested the Death Star servant droid as a potential subject," recalls Keith Tucker. "He's certainly an interesting-looking character, and appears in only two scenes: aboard thc Death Star when Chewie is 'taken prisoner'; and in the sandcrawler." Tucker, a professional illustrator for 20 years, has achieved a wide range of artistic accomplishments in the areas of editorial illustration, comic book work and commercial graphics. Projects include TOM AND JERRY, GARFIELD, ANIMANIACS, DUCK TALES and CONAN (storyboard artist), STAR TREK II and THE THING (live-action effects) and TINY TOONS and THE LITTLE MERMAID (penciling and painting assignments).
